name: Full export
description: Full export of the organization (zip with records, relationships, files, configuration and manifest) and its restoration

page.title: Full export
page.description: Build a package with all the data of the organization for backup, auditing or to move it to another Aphel installation.

request.title: New export
request.description: The package is built in the background. You get a notification when it is ready to download.
request.includeFilesHint: Attachments go into the zip with their original content. Uncheck it for a smaller package with data only.
request.privacyNote: The file gathers the personal data of every record. Keep it somewhere safe and delete copies you no longer need.
request.queued: Export requested. We will let you know when it is done.
request.inProgress: An export is already in progress

contents.records: Records of every type, including custom objects, as JSON Lines, with custom fields by key
contents.relations: Links between records: people and organizations, custom relationships, tags and attachments
contents.history: Notes, stage history and timeline events
contents.config: Configuration package (fields, workflow, layouts, views, automations and the other sections)
contents.manifest: Manifest with format version, Aphel version, counts and SHA-256 checksums

restore.title: Restore in another installation
restore.description: There are two ways to restore a package on another installation.
restore.empty: The destination organization must be empty (no records). The configuration package is applied before the data and the original ids are kept when possible.
restore.members: Users are matched by email to the members of the destination organization; anyone who is not a member is left without an owner.
restore.installer: On the first screen of a new installation, use the “Restore from a backup” link and upload the zip.
restore.cli: Or, from the server command line, on an organization that already exists:

history.title: Previous exports
history.emptyDescription: Exports you build show up here to download.
history.retention: Each package holds personal data from every record. Delete the ones you no longer need.
history.deleteDescription: The zip file will be deleted and can no longer be downloaded. Your organization data is not affected.
history.failedHint: The export could not be completed. Try generating it again; if it keeps failing, tell your administrator.
